name: Agent-Reach
description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
one_liner: A one-command installer that lets an AI assistant actually read Twitter, Reddit, YouTube transcripts, and other sites that normally block scrapers or charge for API access, without paying those API fees.
buyer: A social-media manager or market researcher who needs to monitor what people are saying about a brand across platforms but can't afford Twitter/Reddit API costs.
business_use_cases: A brand monitoring freelancer tracks mentions and sentiment about a client's product across Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube comments without paying for each platform's API.
A market researcher pulls competitor reviews and community discussion from Reddit and YouTube to build a weekly competitive intelligence brief.
A content creator's assistant watches trending topics across platforms and drafts response/reaction content ideas same-day.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'social listening without the API bill' service to small brands: weekly cross-platform mention and sentiment report.
Offer a managed-setup fee for non-technical clients who want this running but can't configure the cookie/login steps themselves.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple weekly digest generator: point it at a brand name, pull mentions across three platforms, and email a short summary — sell it to a local business as a cheap alternative to Brandwatch.
